candidates.content_angle: Explains the bans on illegal racing, weaving, zigzagging and continuous revving in Article 9(5) of Law 36/2024/QH15 and on letting go with both hands, riding on one wheel, sitting sideways, standing or lying on the bike, swapping riders while moving, turning backwards to steer, riding blindfolded and dragging the side stand on the road in Article 33(3)(d)-(e); the penalties in Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for motorbike riders: VND 8,000,000 to 10,000,000 for weaving or dragging the stand (7(9)(a)), riding in a group of two or more bikes above the speed limit (7(9)(b)), steering from behind the person in front except with a child under six in front (7(9)(h)), riding in a convoy that obstructs traffic without a permit (7(9)(i)) and continuous horn or revving in residential and hospital areas (7(9)(k)), each with licence suspension of 10 to 12 months (7(12)(b)); confiscation of the motorbike for riding with both hands off, steering with the feet, sitting sideways, lying on the seat, swapping riders while moving, turning backwards or riding blindfolded, wheelies and repeated weaving (7(11)), with licence suspension of 22 to 24 months (7(12)(c)); on-the-spot impoundment under Article 48(1); and general advice on filming, group rides and showing off on a rented motorbike.
candidates.working_title: ベトナムでのバイクの蛇行運転・手放し運転・ウィリー：車両が没収される違反

references.title: ベトナム政府ポータル：道路交通秩序・安全法（法律36/2024/QH15）統合版 (第9条・第33条)
ベトナム政府政策ポータル：政令168/2024/NĐ-CP全文（道路交通の行政違反の罰則） (第7条・第48条)

distinct_from.reason: JA-S58はグループツーリングと並走の禁止を扱います。このテーマは蛇行運転や手放し運転などの危険な乗り方と、車両没収まである罰則を扱います。
JA-S28は道路の種類ごとの制限速度を扱います。このテーマは蛇行運転からウィリーまでの危険な運転と、その罰則を扱います。
JA-S67は免許、書類、飲酒を理由に警察がバイクを押収する場合を扱います。このテーマはバイクそのものが没収される違反を扱います。
